guide.title: How to get a good walkthrough
guide.slow: Walk slowly. Nerfstudio wants ~3 frames per second — measured: more frames make it worse (2668 frames gave 33 fragments). What counts is the movement, not the frame rate.
guide.around: Around the object, not towards it. The viewing angle has to change, otherwise there's no parallax.
guide.steady: Pan smoothly. Jerky pans cause motion blur, and COLMAP can't match blurry frames.
guide.avoid: Avoid: mirrors, glass, large white walls without texture, moving things. Those are the known killers.
guide.duration: One to two minutes are enough for a room.
